versionHistory.changes: Corrected Ascension 1 to grant +1 ATK instead of +1 HP, marked Elite enemies as spoilers, added the Boss Add label to enemy cards, matched Ascension preview text styling across stat names, and refined sidebar readability.

Corrected Ascension 4 so it changes the selectable starting level without applying level scaling twice; restored the expanded Study and Skills interaction by fixing the enemy sticky binding error; refined sidebar navigation readability while keeping the rarity explanation visible.

Corrected Ascension targeting, removed Yanfly default growth values from enemy calculations and display when no note growth is set, restored expanded Study and Skills panels, refined preview coloring, and adjusted sidebar readability.
